summary: Chase vllm-ascend v0.32.0rc1 on cann/vllm (engine vLLM 0.32.0, CANN 9.2.1): new base image tags, mooncake 0.3.14, vllm-router 0.1.17, vllm-omni v0.32.0 commit, LMCache disabled pending an LMCache-Ascend release that supports vLLM 0.32; cuda/rocm vLLM lines already at 0.33.0 and SGLang lines at 0.5.23 with no newer upstream line, so those subscriptions stay unchanged.

cuda/vllm.reason: Base is vLLM 0.33.0 (runner.py.json, support records); the next release line 0.34 does not exist upstream (latest stable is 0.32.0, 0.33.0rc3 is a prerelease of the already-recorded line), so there is nothing to chase.

packages.name: vllm-omni
packages.reason: Commit pin already aligned with vLLM 0.33; unchanged this run.

cuda/sglang.reason: Base is SGLang 0.5.23 which is the latest upstream stable; no newer release line exists.

packages.name: lmcache
packages.reason: Pinned LMCache supporting SGLang 0.5.23; identical to the other CUDA/ROCm subscriptions.

rocm/vllm.reason: Base is vLLM 0.33.0 on both ROCm 7.2 and 10.0 lines; the next release line 0.34 does not exist upstream, so there is nothing to chase.

packages.name: vllm-omni
packages.reason: Commit pin already aligned with vLLM 0.33; unchanged this run.

rocm/sglang.reason: Base is SGLang 0.5.23 which is the latest upstream stable; no newer release line exists.

packages.name: lmcache
packages.reason: Pinned LMCache supporting SGLang 0.5.23; identical to the other CUDA/ROCm subscriptions.

cann/vllm.reason: Chased the vllm-ascend line above the recorded 0.30.0 base: no 0.31 line exists upstream, so the 0.32 line is next and v0.32.0rc1 is its highest eligible prerelease (vllm-ascend tracks prereleases). The release pairs with the documented stable vLLM v0.32.0 engine, CANN 9.2.1, torch/torch-npu 2.10.0/2.10.0.post7, ray >=2.47.1,<=2.48.0 and mooncake-transfer-engine-npu 0.3.14.rc1; base image tags v0.32.0rc1/-a5/-a3/-310p are published per the image-publish workflow matrix and installation docs.

packages.name: vllm-ascend
packages.reason: Prerelease-whitelisted plugin; release notes document pairing with vLLM v0.32.0 and CANN 9.2.1.

packages.name: lmcache
packages.reason: No LMCache-Ascend release supports the vLLM 0.32 KV connector: v0.5.7 declares 'vLLM 0.23-0.30 on CANN 9.2.0' and v0.5.6 only up to vLLM 0.30; keeping the old pair would mix lines, so LMCache is disabled until a plugin release pairs with vLLM 0.32.

packages.name: lmcache-ascend
packages.reason: Same evidence as lmcache: no plugin release supports vLLM 0.32 yet; both pins are cleared together.

packages.name: mooncake
packages.reason: Stable mooncake v0.3.14 publishes mooncake_transfer_engine_npu 0.3.14 wheels (cp39-cp314, x86_64/aarch64), matching the npu 0.3.14.rc1 line the vllm-ascend v0.32.0rc1 release pairs with; mooncake is not prerelease-whitelisted so the stable release is selected.

packages.name: vllm-omni
packages.reason: vllm-omni v0.32.0 release tag, rebased onto vLLM 0.32.0, preferred over a main-branch commit.
